name: com.mochoindiestudio.quest-system
description: A node-graph quest editor and UI-agnostic runtime for Unity. Author quests as staged lists of objectives, driven by named game signals (event id + payload) so the package never needs to know about your inventory, combat or world. Standalone Quest assets are collected into QuestList assets (tutorials, campaigns, side-quest sets). The runtime exposes data, events and a save/load snapshot only -- you drive whatever quest UI your game already uses. Companion to the MIS Dialog System package.
